paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles from a combined analysis of three flaring $\textit{Fermi}$ flat-spectrum radio quasars
suggested_experiment_name: Fermi LAT combined analysis of 3C454.3, CTA 102, and 3C279
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Combined analysis of three bright flaring FSRQs (3C454.3, CTA 102, 3C279) using Fermi-LAT data. The paper excludes the parameter space 5 neV ≲ m_a ≲ 200 neV and g_aγ ≳ 5×10^-12 GeV^-1 at 95% confidence. The exclusion limit is mass-dependent, with the coupling threshold g_aγ ≳ 5×10^-12 GeV^-1 applying across the stated mass range. Encoded as a horizontal line at the coupling threshold spanning the mass range. No ALP signal detected; marginal 2σ preference in CTA 102 alone disappears in combined analysis. The boundary exhibits a characteristic shape with steeper slope at low masses (10–100 neV) and flattening toward higher masses (>500 neV). Sampling density increased near the corner region (~100 neV) where the slope changes. The text reports the best-fit point at m_a = 100.8 neV and g_aγ = 4.64 × 10^-12 GeV^-1 from CTA 102 data (marked with gold cross in Figure 9). The combined analysis excludes 5 neV ≲ m_a ≲ 200 neV and g_aγ ≳ 5 × 10^-12 GeV^-1 at 95% confidence.
